notes.content:
Dear Players,
    we have fixed some tiny bugs in the game. Optimized the performance of the game. Thanks to all players for supporting our game.

notes.title: The call of PaperPlane is officially released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for your patience and support. We have released The call of Paperplane Version 1.0.

The content of this release includes 10 small levels with the theme of a seaside trip, which contains new scenery, BGM, and a small number of challenging obstacles. I hope these elements can bring some exciting experiences to your game!

We are very pleased that we have completed the task of testing and some bug fixes within the expected time so that the full version of the game can meet the players on time. Thanks to all players and friends for their strong support of our studio, and hope to make the game better with your help. 


Here is a preview of some scenes:
[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/3b2978cc86288eb7179e39b1467ff0d3/tenor.gif?itemid=19598907[/img]

[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/07c66484cf3d5533a79ef2c4caa2ff77/tenor.gif?itemid=19599012[/img]

[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/ad978cddf26411b10436f98f0962d74f/tenor.gif?itemid=19657951[/img]

[h2]Price adjustment[/h2]
The price adjustments mentioned in the update notice released last month will be carried out at the same time as the new version is launched.

If you like our game, please give us a thumbs up on Steam! This is very important to us. Thank you!

notes.title: Christmas discount and new scene preview: Seaside!
notes.content:
[h1]The new level will be launched soon[/h1]
Hey everyone, this is Shanhai Game Studio, thank you for your support for the game Paperplane.
We finally completed the third big scene, the seaside!
This scene has a brighter style, I hope it can bring you more surprises.


[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/488c121f7e0a8c558796f0cfc0a2a905/tenor.gif?itemid=19598879[/img]
[img]https://media1.tenor.com/images/98bb92996052d28721e286de55c0b621/tenor.gif?itemid=19598785[/img]

The whale and lightning bolt in the picture above are all newly added obstacles. Players can experience this content after the third scene goes online.


[h1]Christmas discount[/h1]
To celebrate the upcoming Christmas and New Year's Day double festivals, we decided to give a 20% discount to The Call of paperplane. Thanks to all the people who have been supporting us!

[h1]Price adjustment notice[/h1]

 As the title says, we will end the EA stage of the Paper Airplane after this update and release the official version.
So after the Christmas promotion ends, we will increase the price of the game to USD3.99 on next year.
We will continue to update Paperplane’s new DLC and some small easter eggs in the scenes, these updated content will be free.
Since early access, we have received a lot of valuable feedback and experience reports. We hope you guys will continue to support our development work at the official release and help us make more fun games.
Wish you all have fun!

notes.title: The Call of the paperplane Early Access Is Launched!!
notes.content:
"The Call of Paper Planes" is officially launched!! 
The current version of the game is an early access version that includes the first 20 levels, and subsequent updates will be completed in the next few months.
This is a casual adventure game that wants to give players comfortable and relaxing gaming experience. There are a lot of interactive easter eggs and interesting collection rewards in the game. Welcome everyone to explore freely.
If you have any feedback and suggestions about the game, please join the group and contact us:
Discord: https://discord.gg/z4ZMUqz
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ShanhaiGame
The game is priced at ￥2.99, I hope you like our game!
